name: fetch_api_data
description: Fetches all users (paginated) and every user's orders from the JSON API, retrying 429s via Retry-After. Saves raw data to the given dataPath ({users, ordersByUser}) and writes totals.json (sum of completed order amounts per user id) to totalsPath. Returns counts.
whenToUse: To download the full users/orders dataset and compute completed totals; the saved data file can answer later questions.

dataPath.description: Raw data output path relative to project root

totalsPath.description: totals.json path relative to project root

countStatus.description: Optional: order status to count per user

countsPath.description: Optional: output path for per-user counts of countStatus

sumStatus.description: Optional: status whose amounts are summed per user

sinceDate.description: Optional: only orders with createdAt >= this YYYY-MM-DD

sumPath.description: Optional: output path for per-user sums of sumStatus (zero sums omitted)

provenance.reason: paginated fetch + per-user orders with 429 retry
